d: Long, flowing crimson hair with blunt bangs and two high pigtails tied with black ribbons, topped by a dark navy beret with a silver star emblem. Sharp, narrowed eyes of a bright amber-orange shade on a face with a youthful, adolescent appearance. A slender build wearing an oversized, ochre-orange zip-up jacket with a high collar and black strap details, layered over a short grey pleated skirt and sheer black tights. Black ankle boots and a red belt with a silver buckle around the waist, while one hand holds a black rectangular folder with white handwritten text.
